messages.tip.action_button: Runs this action using the current data and parameter values.
messages.tip.angle: Minim angular separation, in degrees, between accepted density maxima. Larger values keep fewer, more widely separated principal poles; smaller values may retain nearby peaks from the same orientation familie.
messages.tip.bins: Sets the KDE density-grid level as 2^N cells per axis. Higher values reveal finer density detail but require more memory and computation. Use the lowest value that resolves stable density maxima.
messages.tip.classify_action: Assigns each point to the closest reviewed principal pole within the JS cone threshold and writes the JS câmp scalar. The reviewed pole table, not the original automatic peaks, is used.
messages.tip.colour.dof: Select the number of rotation degrees of freedom. Use 2 for the original two-angle rotation model or 3 for the intrinsic Z-Y-X Euler rotation used by the three-degree-of-freedom model.
messages.tip.colour.objective: Select the objective function minimised during optimisation. It controls how the rotated pole orientations are penalised or distributed in the colour reference system.
messages.tip.colour.subsample: Percentage of valid point normale used during optimisation. Lower percentages reduce computation time; 100% uses all valid normale.
messages.tip.colour.iterations: Maxim number of differential-evolution generations. Higher values allow a more extensive search but increase computation time.
messages.tip.colour.population: Population multiplier used by differential evolution. Larger values evaluate more candidate rotations per generation, increasing search effort and computation time.
messages.tip.colour.seed: Optional integer random seed. Enter a value to make the sampling and optimisation reproducible; leave blank to use a new random seed.
messages.tip.colour.export_copy: Creates a new CloudCompare nor de puncte coloured using the selected colour space and the selected pole space. The original nor de puncte is not modified.
messages.tip.colour.show_density: Displays the relative pole-density distribution obtained with the optimised rotation. It does not run the optimisation again.
messages.tip.colour.show_poles: Displays the point-normală poles after applying the optimised rotation, using the selected stereonet projection.
messages.tip.clouds: When fațete are created, also creates one separate nor de puncte for each final cluster. Disable this for very large datasets if the additional clouds use too much memory.
messages.tip.cluster: Runs DBSCAN independently within each positive JS familie, estimates a familie-specific eps, removes components smaller than ppcluster, fits plan equations, and writes cl, A, B, C, D and sigma using the original global point indices.
messages.tip.colour.optimise: Starts the normală-colour optimisation with the parameters entered above and determines the rotation angles that minimise the selected objective function.
messages.tip.dbscanminpts: Minim number of points inside the DBSCAN neighbourhood, including the point itself, required for a core point. The MATLAB method uses 4. Increasing this value requires denser neighbourhoods and may classify more points as noise.
messages.tip.density_action: Calculates the KDE pole-density surface and extracts automatic principal poles. Review and, if necessary, edit the resulting pole table before assigning JS familii.
messages.tip.editable_param: Editable parameter. Enter a numeric value where appropriate; the associated label indicates the units and the parameter effect.
messages.tip.facets: Creates one convex planar mesh for each valid final cluster using its stored global point indices and fitted plan. Clustering must be completed first.
messages.tip.family_clouds: After clustering, creates one nor de puncte for each positive JS familie. Each nor de puncte contains that familie’s points and retains the JS, cl and plan câmpuri scalare.
messages.tip.family_plot_action: Plots point normale coloured by their current JS value and overlays the reviewed principal poles. This is available only when JS corresponds to the current reviewed pole table.
messages.tip.fix: When selected, each cluster in a JS familie uses the reviewed familie-pole normală and derives only D from the cluster centroid. When cleared, each cluster normală is fitted locally using PCA/SVD.
messages.tip.jscone: Maxim angular difference, in degrees, between a point normală and a reviewed principal pole. The closest pole inside this cone defines JS; points outside all cones receive JS=0.
messages.tip.kneighbor: Neighbour order used to estimate eps separately for each JS familie. The MATLAB method uses K=4 and queries K+1 neighbours because the first result is the point itself. Larger K represents a broader local spacing scale.
messages.tip.ksigma: Multiplier in eps = mean(unique KNN distances) + k_sigma × sample standard deviation. The MATLAB method uses 2. Larger values increase eps and tend to join components across wider gaps; smaller values tend to split clustere.
messages.tip.labels: Shows cardinal directions, angular guides and stereonet annotations. These guides are visual only and do not affect the calculations.
messages.tip.maxpoles: Maxim number of automatic principal poles retained from the density surface. It limits the candidate JS familii; the reviewed pole table remains authoritative and can be edited manually.
messages.tip.merge: Coplanarity threshold based on |Di-Dj|/(sigma_i+sigma_j). Larger values merge more same-familie clustere into a common plan; smaller values preserve more separate planuri. Set 0 to disable this merge.
messages.tip.minclustersize: Minim component size after DBSCAN, corresponding to MATLAB ppcluster. Components with fewer points are rejected and assigned cl=0. This does not control whether a point is a DBSCAN core point.
messages.tip.plot_poles: Plots all valid point normale as poles on the selected stereonet projection. This is a visual inspection step and does not modify the nor de puncte.
messages.tip.pole_add: Adds a new principal pole from the Direcția înclinării and Înclinare values. The table and density plot update immediately; familie IDs are renumbered and existing JS and cluster results become outdated.
messages.tip.pole_apply: Applies the Direcția înclinării and Înclinare values to the selected principal pole. The reviewed table becomes the source of truth, so JS classification and clustering must then be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_delete: Deletes the selected principal pole, renumbers the remaining familii and refreshes the plot. Existing JS and cluster results become outdated.
messages.tip.pole_down: Moves the selected pole one row down. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes familie IDs and requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_move: Changes the familie order. Because familie IDs follow table order, changing the order requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_table: Authoritative reviewed list of principal poles. JS classification, familie plots, Fisher K and subsequent clustering use this exact order and orientation. Editing or reordering the table invalidates existing JS and cluster results.
messages.tip.pole_up: Moves the selected pole one row up. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes familie IDs and requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.poles.source: Choose whether pole plots, density and automatic peak detection use the original normale or normale transformed by the optimised rotation. Stored principal-pole orientations always remain in the original reference system.
messages.tip.projection: Selects the stereographic projection used for plots. Unghi egal preserves angular relationships; equal-area preserves area. This setting changes only the visual projection, not the original point normale or câmpuri scalare.
messages.tip.refresh: Refreshes the selected CloudCompare entity and checks which workflow actions and Instrumente commands have the data required to run.
messages.tip.seed: Optional integer used only with Aleator cluster ordering. The same seed reproduces the numbering; leave blank to generate a new random order for each run.
messages.tip.show_density: Displays the last computed density and current principal poles without recalculating the KDE or detecting peaks.
messages.tip.sort: Controls final cl numbering within each JS familie. Size orders the largest clustere first, D follows their spatial position along the fitted normală, and Aleator shuffles the order. IDs restart at 1 for each familie.
messages.tip.style: Chooses line contours or filled contours for the density plot. This changes visualisation only; density values and detected poles are not recalculated.

messages.about.body:
Authors:
  Adrián Riquelme Guill
  Roberto Tomás Jover
  Antonio Abellán Fernández
  University of Alicante

Scientific references:
  Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., Tomas, R., & Jaboyedoff, M. (2014).
  A new approach for semi-automatic rock mass joints recognition
  from 3D point clouds. Computers & Geosciences, 68, 38-52.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cageo.2014.03.014

  Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., & Tomas, R. (2015).
  Discontinuity spacing analysis in rock masses using 3D point clouds.
  Engineering Geology, 195, 185-195.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.enggeo.2015.06.009

  Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2018).
  Automatic mapping of discontinuity persistence on rock masses using
  3D point clouds. Rock Mechanics and Rock Engineering, 51, 3005-3028.
  https://doi.org/10.1007/s00603-018-1519-9

  Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2026).
  Orientation-based colour mapping and spherical density analysis for
  rock discontinuity detection in 3D point clouds of roadcut slopes.
  Journal of Rock Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jrmge.2025.12.059

  Riquelme Guill, A. (2015).
  Uso de nubes de puntos 3D para identificación y caracterización de
  familias de discontinuidades planas en afloramientos rocosos y
  evaluación de la calidad geomecánica. Doctoral thesis, University of
  Alicante.
  https://rua.ua.es/entities/publication/78d254b9-1a7b-49b1-a35a-c0edbdeeb225

Based on:
  Adrian Riquelme's MATLAB implementation of the Discontinuity Set
  Extractor (DSE), Department of Civil Engineering, University of
  Alicante, Spain.

Libraries and algorithms:
  - NumPy: numerical arrays and vector operations.
  - SciPy: KDE, differential evolution, nearest-neighbour queries,
    connected components and convex-hull geometry.
  - Matplotlib: stereonet, density and analysis plotting.
  - colorcet: scientific and perceptually useful colour maps used by
    the cluster visualisation.
  - Pillow: icon loading, resizing and GUI icon normalisation.
  - CloudCompare / pycc: point-nor de puncte, normală and scalar-field access.
  - Tkinter / ttk: graphical user interface.
  - PyVista (optional): interactive 3D normală/sphere visualisation.

  Algorithms and methods:
  - DSE principal-pole extraction using spherical/steronet KDE, based on
    the Botev et al. kernel-density approach.
  - Differential Evolution for normală-colour rotation optimisation.
  - DBSCAN (Ester et al., 1996) for spatial clustering of discontinuity
    familii.
  - Fisher directional statistics for mean-pole concentration and
    confidence intervals.
  - cKDTree nearest-neighbour searches and Qhull convex-hull geometry
    through SciPy.

Acknowledgments:
  CloudCompare development team and the researchers whose methods
  underpin the DSE workflow.
